description: This source file defines React components related to exporting and previewing chat messages, including modal dialogs, image export, markdown and JSON previews, and sharing functionalities within a chat application.

classes.name: ExportMessageModal
classes.description: A React component rendering a modal dialog for exporting messages.

classes.name: MessageExporter
classes.description: A React component providing UI for selecting export format, preview, and configuration.

classes.name: RenderExport
classes.description: A React component that renders chat messages and invokes a callback on render.

classes.name: PreviewActions
classes.description: A React component with actions to copy, download, and share message exports.

classes.name: ImagePreviewer
classes.description: A React component for previewing chat images, with options to copy or download.

classes.name: MarkdownPreviewer
classes.description: A React component rendering a markdown preview of chat messages.

classes.name: JsonPreviewer
classes.description: A React component rendering JSON preview of chat messages.

methods.name: useSteps
methods.description: Custom hook managing step navigation within export interface.

methods.name: updateExportConfig
methods.description: Function to update the export configuration state.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Function returning the current preview component based on selected export format.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads the current message preview as an image.

methods.name: refreshPreview
methods.description: Refreshes the image preview DOM content.
